title: External exchange and internal connection authorization need reviewed evidence
remediation: The sponsor boundary owner and privacy authority inventory internal connections and external exchanges separately. Approve interfaces, information types, safeguards, owners and review rules. Retain an approved external agreement and a sampled internal configuration and security and privacy check before connection, as applicable. Record approved review, termination conditions and any exceptions.

milestones.title: Collect approved exchange and connection register entries, applicable agreements and an assessed preconnection safeguard check
